scope: Executed fixed-M8 finite C2 export. Numerical sample metrics are not continuous certificates.
source_scope: Exact C2 integrated-quartic derivative perturbation plus one fixed analytic rotational background; shared binary nodes, endpoint derivative jets, physical-midpoint first derivatives and C3 coefficients. Sampling is not a continuous metric/curvature certificate. Planar rr source uses finite differences; ODE and far nonlinear graph errors remain unpaid. Sampled target jets are evaluated at the source profile radius; maxSourceRadiusDisplayDifference records the numerical shift to the exact-sum representation. No continuous certification is inferred from these samples. Each stage endpoint shooting defect is distributed through one physical-r cubic Hermite correction to Fr; its exact derivative corrects Frr. This is part of the finite map definition, not an exact ODE correction.
